claim: Implements the OR oracle for f(x)=x0 OR x1 by applying X to q[2] when (q[0] OR q[1])=1, using the decomposition OR = XOR ⊕ AND.
Implements U = RZ(π/2) * RY(π/3) by applying RY(π/3) first, then RZ(π/2).
Decomposes the Hadamard gate using only RZ and RX rotations via the standard decomposition H ≈ RZ(π/2)·RX(π/2)·RZ(π/2), with global phase ignored.
Implements RZZ(π/3) using only CX and RZ gates via the standard decomposition with angle factors.
Implements the iSWAP gate using three CX gates and two S gates, performing simultaneous swap and iπ/2 phase on |11⟩ state.
Prepares the state cos(π/8)|0⟩ + e^(iπ/4)sin(π/8)|1⟩ using RY(π/4) for amplitude and RZ(π/4) for phase.
Applies a controlled-Hadamard gate with control on q[0] and target on q[1].
Prepares the GHZ state (|000⟩ + |111⟩)/√2 on q[0..2], then measures all three qubits into a 3-bit classical register.
Swaps the values of q[0] and q[2] using exactly three CX gates in the standard SWAP decomposition.
Attempts to prepare the Dicke state D(4,2) as an equal superposition of all 4-qubit basis states with exactly two 1s, using controlled operations and Hadamards.
